name: lever belt romanian deadlift (straight bar)
description: A Romanian deadlift on a belt-loaded lever machine using a straight bar. It builds the hamstrings and glutes while sparing the grip and spine from heavy free weight.
instructions: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.
